BlackRock Greater Europe Investment Trust plc (‘the Company’) LEI – 5493003R8FJ6I76ZUW55 Transaction in own shares: purchase of own shares to be held in treasury The Company announces that it has today purchased 13,791 of its Ordinary Shares at an average price of 593.91 pence per share to be held in treasury. Following settlement of this purchase on 04 September 2026 the issued share capital of the Company will be 89,681,668 Ordinary Shares, excluding 28,247,270 shares which are held in treasury. Shares held in treasury do not carry any voting rights; 23.95% of the Company’s total issued share capital (117,928,938 Ordinary Shares, including treasury shares) will be held in treasury following settlement. For reporting purposes under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules the market should exclude any shares held in treasury and should use the figure of 89,681,668 following settlement when determining if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in the Company. All enquiries:
William Rowledge
Company Secretary BlackRock Investment Management (UK) Limited Tel: 0207 743 2284

02 September 2026
